purpose: The one Webflow site flowsmith evals may write to and staging-publish. Evals never touch a client site.
plan_requirement: The site sits in a paid Workspace plan, where a Starter site gets up to 300 static pages and custom code at no extra cost, or carries a paid CMS site plan (Basic has no CMS, and L-85 needs a collection). A free Starter site in a free workspace allows 2 static pages and no custom code, which blocks L-81, L-83 and L-88 and the page-per-case reset below.
case_page_slug: eval-<case id in lower case>, for example eval-l-83
rules: Writes and staging publishes are allowed only when every Webflow call's siteId equals site_id.
custom_domains stays empty, so every publish is publishToWebflowSubdomain true with customDomains [].
Each case runs on its own case page, created once with data_pages_tool create_page and reused on every run. data_pages_tool has no delete action, so never create a page per run.
Before each case, get_all_elements depth 1 on the case page, remove_element every child of Body, and clear that page's head and footer freeform code, so the case starts blank.

Anything site-wide a case writes (site head or footer code, variables, styles, CMS collections and items) is named with the prefix eval_<case id>_ and removed by the case's last step. Anything the API cannot delete is reused by name on the next run, never recreated.
